answer: Cross-Binding Continuity Proofs. Each identity must periodically submit a signed sensor trace recorded by one physical device whose clock drifts against an ember of hardware entropy, chained to prior traces. A second identity requires a second device exhibiting independent drift. Verification checks that drift curves never correlate across claimed identities. An attacker must acquire and run separate hardware per identity, sustaining real power and clock variation—an island of cost per fake.
